description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530176
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, cadastral references, and land registration particulars. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
